description: This file defines a Java interface named EcuQuery that extends another interface Query. It specifies method signatures for accessing ECU query data such as addresses, raw bytes, hexadecimal representation, and setting response bytes.

classes.name: EcuQuery
classes.description: Interface for ECU query objects, providing methods to retrieve query data and set responses.

methods.name: getAddresses
methods.description: Returns an array of addresses involved in the ECU query.

methods.name: getBytes
methods.description: Retrieves the raw byte array representing the query or response.

methods.name: getHex
methods.description: Returns a hexadecimal string representation of the data.

methods.name: setResponse
methods.description: Sets the response data for the query using a byte array.
